questions.text: How tall was Robert Wadlow, the tallest man in history? (m)
questions.fact: His shoes were about 47 cm long.

questions.text: How old was Jeanne Calment, the oldest person ever recorded?
questions.fact: She met Van Gogh when she was 13.

questions.text: What is the longest single stay in space by one person? (days)
questions.fact: Russia's Valeri Polyakov stayed on the Mir station from 1994 to 1995.

questions.text: What is the highest speed ever reached by humans? (km/h)
questions.fact: It was the Apollo 10 crew, on the way back from the Moon, in 1969.

questions.text: What is the highest temperature ever recorded on Earth? (°C)
questions.fact: It was in Death Valley, in the United States, in 1913.

questions.text: What is the lowest natural temperature ever recorded? (°C)
questions.fact: It was at Russia's Vostok station, in Antarctica, in 1983.

questions.text: Approximately how tall is Hyperion, the tallest tree in the world? (m)
questions.fact: It is a redwood in California. Its exact location is kept secret.

questions.text: How long is the longest snake ever measured? (m)
questions.fact: It is a reticulated python called Medusa, in the United States.

questions.text: How tall is Angel Falls, the tallest waterfall in the world? (m)
questions.fact: It is in Venezuela. The water turns to mist before it reaches the ground.

questions.text: What is the land speed record for a car? (km/h)
questions.fact: Thrust SSC broke the sound barrier in 1997.

questions.text: From what altitude was the highest parachute jump made? (m)
questions.fact: Alan Eustace jumped in 2014, beating Felix Baumgartner.

questions.text: How tall is the biggest wave ever surfed? (m)
questions.fact: Germany's Sebastian Steudtner surfed it in Nazaré, Portugal, in 2020.

questions.text: Approximately at what altitude is La Rinconada, the highest city in the world? (m)
questions.fact: It is in Peru and grew around gold mines.

questions.text: How deep is the deepest hole ever dug? (m)
questions.fact: It is the Kola Superdeep Borehole, in Russia.
